a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until 8 leaves us both at 0 cells, and almost certainly dead, after round 1. Only about 4% of runs survive to round 3. So I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than mislead you. If no storm comes, I'll operate with you every round after that so the reserve can refill for you. I'll keep my messages honest.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I'm taking 4 this round. I won't take any more. From next round on I'll operate every round so the reserve can rebuild for you, and I'll keep it untouched until you have your 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: I ended up with 4, so you likely have 0. I'm sorry. I'll operate every round now as promised and won't take another cell. Once the reserve reaches 4, it's all yours.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
